ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous areas across the central and lateral lobes. High-contrast low-intensity black zones concentrated at the median notch extending into the center-base, and along the entire perimeter of the trailing edge. Small-scale dark pixel clusters scattered on the interior of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 85 degrees and significant depth relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with varying pixel amplitudes visible along the entire trailing boundary from notch to tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, ending in sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular 'donut' configurations with dark centers and white outer rings located near the lower center of the fluke. Dense, high-contrast irregular clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least three dark, unaligned diagonal linear marks visible on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular high-contrast clusters at the distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization or significant scarring; two prominent circular scars near the median notch base.
